title: bee team show, the models alias, and the two D2 warnings
action:
Four things, all on the verb and hook surface.

1. **The verb.** Rename the `models` command group to `team` in the command registry (`catalog.rs` — see the `resolve(&["models","show"])` assertion at `catalog.rs:816`, which must become `team`) and in `verbs/models_group.rs` (rename the file's public entry to `team show`; keep the module name if churn is large). `bee team show` is the canonical verb.

2. **The alias.** Add `("models", &["team"])` to `FLOW_VERBS` at `router.rs:173-176`, the same table that maps `gate` to `state gate`. Because the help probe runs on argv BEFORE the rewrite (`router.rs:203-212`), `models` still needs its own registry entry — keep one that documents itself as a deprecated alias. When the alias is used, print exactly ONE line to **stderr**: `bee models show is now bee team show — the config block is team.<runtime>.<role>; models is a read alias.` stdout and `--json` must be byte-identical to `bee team show` (the verb emits JSON through `ctx.emit` at `models_group.rs:235`; a stdout line would corrupt it).

3. **The doctor warning.** A TOP-LEVEL check (not inside the per-runtime `hat_slots_missing_a_description` at `doctor.rs:294`, which would print twice and never see pi/opencode): read the raw config, call `fold_team_key` on a copy, and if it returns true emit ONE advisory: `.bee/config.json still uses the models key — rename it to team (models is read as an alias for now).` When both keys are present, the line says `team` is used and `models` is ignored.

4. **The preamble line.** In `hooks/session_preamble/budget.rs`, inside the `### Dispatch door` section (:649), when the fold reported the legacy key: ONE terse line, `- config: .bee/config.json uses the legacy models key — rename to team.` Nothing else, and never when the config already says `team`.

Tests: alias output equality (stdout and JSON) plus exactly one stderr line; doctor emits one line on a models-only fixture, none on team; preamble the same; both-keys case names the ignored key.
verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --no-fail-fast --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml --bin bee -- models_group router doctor session_preamble catalog

truths: bee team show is the canonical verb and bee models show still works
the alias's stdout and --json are byte-identical to bee team show; exactly one line goes to stderr
bee doctor emits exactly one line on a models-only config and none on a team config, from a top-level check
the preamble emits exactly one terse line in Dispatch door on a models-only config and none otherwise
the both-keys case names the ignored key

trace.outcome: bee team show is the verb; bee models show is a router alias with a stderr notice; doctor and the preamble each carry one legacy-key line

report.outcome: FLOW_VERBS gains (models, [team]) at router.rs:177 and the alias path prints one stderr line (router.rs:219-226); the models registry entry stays for the help probe; team_config_advisory (doctor.rs:352) runs top-level per doctor invocation and prints one note on a models config, none on team, and the ignored-key wording when both are present; budget.rs:656 prints the one-line Dispatch-door note on a legacy config.
